## Plugin reference

- Description: Pages trash consumer: contributes a Trash entry into the Pages sidebar, opening a dialog that lists soft-deleted pages as a live DataView with Restore and Delete permanently row actions.
- Web:
  - Slots: `item-actions`
  - Slot contributors: `item-actions` ← `apps.pages.trash`
  - Contributes:
    - `Pages.Sidebar` "Trash" → `PagesTrash`
    - `item-actions` "restore" → `RestoreTrashEntryAction`
    - `item-actions` "purge" → `PurgeTrashEntryAction`

    - `apps/pages/shell.Pages`
